clauses.title: Party identification
clauses.content: This Agreement is entered into between [Client] (the "Client") and [Provider] (the "Provider"). Demo sample — legal review required.

clauses.title: Scope of services
clauses.content: The Provider shall render the services described in the attached schedule diligently and in a professional manner. Demo sample — legal review required.

clauses.title: Payment terms
clauses.content: In consideration of the services, the Client shall pay the Provider the amount of {amount} in {currency}, payable per the invoice schedule. Demo sample — legal review required.

clauses.title: Late payment
clauses.content: Any amount unpaid thirty (30) days after its due date shall bear interest at the statutory rate applicable under Moroccan law. Demo sample — legal review required.

clauses.title: Deadlines
clauses.content: The Provider shall deliver the deliverables on or before the agreed deadlines, unless delayed by force majeure. Demo sample — legal review required.

clauses.title: Confidentiality
clauses.content: Each party shall keep confidential all non-public information received from the other party and shall use it solely for the purposes of this Agreement. Demo sample — legal review required.

clauses.title: Liability
clauses.content: The Provider's aggregate liability under this Agreement shall not exceed the total fees paid by the Client under it, except in case of fraud or gross negligence. Demo sample — legal review required.

clauses.title: Termination
clauses.content: This Agreement may be terminated by either party upon thirty (30) days written notice, or immediately upon a material breach that remains uncured for fifteen (15) days. Demo sample — legal review required.

clauses.title: Dispute resolution
clauses.content: The parties shall first attempt to settle disputes amicably; failing that, disputes shall be submitted to the competent courts of Morocco. Demo sample — legal review required.

clauses.title: Governing law
clauses.content: This Agreement is governed by and construed in accordance with Moroccan law, including the Dahir of 12 August 1913 (Obligations and Contracts, D.O.C.). Demo sample — legal review required.

riskPlaybook.name: ma_service_agreement_risks
rules: Unresolved placeholders indicate an incomplete section.
Currency mismatch between facts and payment section.
Missing governing law section for Moroccan contract.
Late payment interest above statutory ceiling.
Liability cap absent or excessive exposure.

chunks.content: Article 230 D.O.C.: Obligations must be performed in good faith. Demo sample — legal review required.
Article 259 D.O.C.: Where no price is fixed by the parties, the price shall be the one customarily charged at the time of performance. Demo sample — legal review required.
Late payment interest in contractual matters must not exceed the statutory ceiling. Demo sample — legal review required.
